featured_reviews.name: ANKATOLLA Giridhar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great Budget Hostel with Amazing Vibes!!

I stayed at this hostel in December and was genuinely impressed—especially considering how budget-friendly it is!

The location is hands-down the best part. It's surrounded by fantastic street food stalls, local eateries, and cafes. Everything was within walking distance, and public transport (local train, metro) was super convenient. I saved so much time and money on commuting.

I booked in a 10-bed mixed dorm, and I was a bit worried about noise or privacy at first. Surprisingly, it was very peaceful! Everyone was respectful, people kept voices down at night, and I slept really well every night. No disturbances at all. The beds were comfortable, with clean linens, power sockets, and decent-sized lockers.

For the price, this place offers incredible value. Clean facilities, hot showers, free Wi-Fi that actually worked well, If you're traveling on a budget and want a relaxed vibe without compromising on location or comfort, I highly recommend this hostel. I'll definitely be back next time when I'm in mumbai ❤️

featured_reviews.name: soraya benachir
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great experience at this hostel! Everything went really smoothly during my stay — the atmosphere was welcoming, the place was clean, and the staff were friendly and helpful. I especially appreciated that they kindly allowed me to store my luggage for a few hours after check-out, which made my travel plans much easier. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it!

featured_reviews.name: Mahesh Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very close (5-10 min walk) from CSMT Railway Station and Bus Station. It is fully AC Dormitory.  Bunk Beds are provided, no seperate rooms. Charges of Beds can vary but most probably they provide bed at 350rs/night. 10 am is checkout time. You can check in any time. Good staff and service. Dormitory is very clean, clean bedsheets, blankets and pillow also provided.

The total capacity of dormitory is 40 beds, there are 4 common washrooms (size is very small), cleanliness is maintained 24 hours. I stayed here for 2 nights.

There were bedbugs, but they did pest control so I think now it will be fine.

There are many other dormitory also in that area.. 350rs is standard price. But they can charge 400-500 also especially if someone referred you.

I will rate my overall stay as 4 star. As the staff was very friendly.

If you will take upper beds then be little mindful of fans, rest is fine.

24 hours free wifi, drinking water, locker also provided.
